# Verb list

<!-- Generated from src/data/verbs.ts by `npm run docs:verbs`. Do not edit by hand. -->

All 70 verbs the app asks about, grouped by the step in which they are introduced,
with every sentence each verb can appear in.

- **Bold** is the answer and _italics_ mark the clue words that tell which form to use.
- ★ marks a sentence written for that verb; the others come from shared templates.
- Shared templates choose the subject and time at random; one choice is shown here.
- "— (not used)" means the verb is never asked with that template, usually because it sounds unnatural.

### go — 行く

go / goes / went / gone / going（ABC型）

| Question | Sentence | Explanation (verb-specific sentences only) |
|---|---|---|
| Base · present | _We_ **go** to the park _every day_. | |
| Base · did question | _Did_ you **go** to the park yesterday? | |
| Base · does question | _Does_ she **go** to the park? | |
| Base · after a modal | She _can_ **go** to the park. | |
| 3rd person singular | _She_ **goes** to the park _every day_. | |
| Past | We **went** to the park _last Sunday_. | |
| Past participle · perfect ★ | Ken _has_ already **gone** home. | has ＋ 過去分詞で「もう〜した」「ちょうど〜したところ」（現在完了）。have / has のあとは過去分詞です。 |
| ing · progressive | He _is_ **going** to the park _now_. | |

### know — 知っている

know / knows / knew / known / knowing（ABC型）

| Question | Sentence | Explanation (verb-specific sentences only) |
|---|---|---|
| Base · present ★ | _We_ **know** his name. | 主語が「We」なので3人称単数ではありません。現在の文でも -s は付けず、原形のままです。 |
| Base · did question ★ | _Did_ you **know** his name? | Did の疑問文では「過去」の意味を did が受け持つので、動詞は原形にもどります。 |
| Base · does question | _Does_ she **know** his name? | |
| Base · after a modal | — (not used) | |
| 3rd person singular ★ | _Ken_ **knows** her name. | 主語が「Ken」（3人称単数）で、今の状態を表す現在の文なので -s（-es）が付きます。 |
| Past ★ | I **knew** him _when I was a child_. | 「when I was a child」は過去を表す言葉なので、過去形を使います。 |
| Past participle · perfect ★ | I _have_ **known** Ken _for three years_. | have ＋ 過去分詞で「ずっと〜している」（現在完了）。have / has のあとは過去分詞です。 |
| Past participle · passive | This song _is_ **known** _to_ everyone. | |
| ing · progressive | — (not used) | |
